mentions.name: Dad Joke Postcards
mentions.description: This website lets users pick a dad joke and a recipient, then prints and mails the joke as a real physical postcard via USPS. $2 from every card sent is donated to the Jazz Foundation of America.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.dadjokepostcards.com — pick a dadjoke and a recipient, the joke gets printed and sent for you on a (real) postcard via USPS.
mentions.author: aaronsnow
